# Debrief: Argo CD, Prometheus

These clips cover Argo CD practices such as keeping Helm values in Git, fast pull request previews, locked-down installs, and API-based troubleshooting that pulls in Prometheus metric context. ([Declarative...ish? Fixing Hidden Argo CD Pitfalls in Your GitOps Setup · 5:39](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VfVQj4Oa3z0&t=339s); [Argo CD: Previewing Pull Request Changes in SECONDS! · 10:49](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fcajag5di68&t=649s); [The 10x DevOps Engineer’s Toolkit: Argo CD + AI-Driven MCP Automation · 15:24](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iC15zeOLZQA&t=924s))

## Top 3 takeaways

1. Store Helm settings in value files in Git and have Argo CD applications reference them, so business settings and deployment targets are cleanly separated and developers can run things locally. ([Declarative...ish? Fixing Hidden Argo CD Pitfalls in Your GitOps Setup · 5:39](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VfVQj4Oa3z0&t=339s))
2. A slimmed-down, namespace-scoped Argo CD with self-hosted runners rendered previews for about 1,000 applications in roughly 5 seconds, giving accurate pull request feedback because the real Argo CD does the rendering. ([Argo CD: Previewing Pull Request Changes in SECONDS! · 10:49](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fcajag5di68&t=649s))
3. Argo CD's API exposes logs, Kubernetes events, and live versus desired state, which helps address data silos spread across tools like Prometheus-metric dashboards, and it underpins an MCP automation approach. ([The 10x DevOps Engineer’s Toolkit: Argo CD + AI-Driven MCP Automation · 15:24](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iC15zeOLZQA&t=924s); [The 10x DevOps Engineer’s Toolkit: Argo CD + AI-Driven MCP Automation · 8:55](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iC15zeOLZQA&t=535s))

## Action items

- [ ] Audit Argo CD applications for Helm parameters embedded in manifests and move them into Helm value files in Git, referenced from the application. ([Declarative...ish? Fixing Hidden Argo CD Pitfalls in Your GitOps Setup · 5:39](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VfVQj4Oa3z0&t=339s))
- [ ] Try a pull request preview pipeline using runners in the same cluster as Argo CD, using watch patterns to render only changed applications. ([Argo CD: Previewing Pull Request Changes in SECONDS! · 10:49](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fcajag5di68&t=649s); [Argo CD: Previewing Pull Request Changes in SECONDS! · 17:19](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fcajag5di68&t=1039s))
- [ ] Evaluate a namespace-scoped, trimmed Argo CD install by removing cluster roles and unneeded components in a non-production setup. ([Argo CD: Previewing Pull Request Changes in SECONDS! · 10:49](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fcajag5di68&t=649s))

## Watch together (5 min)

1. [Declarative...ish? Fixing Hidden Argo CD Pitfalls in Your GitOps Setup · 5:39](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VfVQj4Oa3z0&t=339s) (1:20), Regina Voloshin: Clear Git layout practice for Helm values versus Argo CD manifests.
2. [Argo CD: Previewing Pull Request Changes in SECONDS! · 10:49](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fcajag5di68&t=649s) (1:19), Dag Bjerre Andersen, Sergey Shevchenko: Lockdown mode and 5-second previews on 1,000 applications.
3. [Argo CD: Previewing Pull Request Changes in SECONDS! · 17:19](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fcajag5di68&t=1039s) (1:19), Dag Bjerre Andersen, Sergey Shevchenko: Watch patterns and pre-configured clusters cut preview time dramatically.
4. [The 10x DevOps Engineer’s Toolkit: Argo CD + AI-Driven MCP Automation · 15:24](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iC15zeOLZQA&t=924s) (1:19), Alexander Matyushentsev, Leonardo Luz Almeida: Argo CD API as source for troubleshooting data across silos.
